title: The Museum of Almost
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

successful_carousel_standard.audience_success: Cold viewers recognize the fear of failed versions and can send the carousel to the person who witnessed them.
successful_carousel_standard.creative_success: Five silent scenes create discard, exposure, chronology, re-seeing, and voluntary continuation.
successful_carousel_standard.brand_success: The route is a specific illustrated love archive rather than generic advice or a quote deck.
successful_carousel_standard.production_success: The request lock is one five-slide 1080x1440 Instagram carousel with real identity/style inputs, integrated copy, brandmark, QA, and audit.

human_truth: Being deeply witnessed can mean someone remembers your becoming, not only the version that eventually succeeded.
emotional_arc: discard -> exposure -> chronology -> re-seeing -> voluntary continuation
source_story_summary: During a home desk clear-out, one partner discards a worn folder of unfinished attempts. The other rescues it, opens it without judgment, and arranges the wordless drafts from oldest to newest. The owner first tries to close the folder, then sees a life instead of a failure pile and adds today's unfinished page. This is a generic relationship hypothesis, not a claimed lived Aachu/Zuv fact; do not invent identifiable documents, employers, courses, dates, grades, signatures, or applications.
visual_style: One continuous home clear-out. Use The Folder Changes Hands causal visual system, exact five-line copy, Aachu owns the final action, no museum metaphor, no readable secondary text, default instagram_post only.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

story_selling_contract.rule: Begin concept thinking like an author: find the relationship obstacle, choose one process card, prove the feeling with Aachu/Zuv behavior, then score before writing slides or captions.

story_selling_decision.selected_concept_process_card: Card 20 - Saveable Lesson From One Scene
story_selling_decision.selector_verdict: PASS: the visible discard, rescue, chronology, re-seeing, and current-page addition form one complete relationship story.

stage_scene_gate.action: Aachu discards a worn folder; Zuv retrieves it, opens it without tugging, and orders the unfinished pages; Aachu later adds the current page.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu first tries to close the folder, then releases it and softens after seeing the chronology.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Attention moves from the discard carton to the exposed pages, then to the ordered line and the new page.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: The folder moves from Aachu to the carton to Zuv, then opens; papers become a chronology; Aachu extends it.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Zuv does not praise, explain, hug, or manage her; the ordering and her reaction carry the turn.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: The discarded attempts become a visible record rather than rubbish.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: Aachu voluntarily adds today's unfinished page and turns a rescued archive into a living one.

story_selling_decision.proof_engine: discarded folder -> rescued unfinished attempts -> visible chronology -> changed posture -> current draft added
story_selling_decision.distribution_reason: Send it to the person who remembered you before anything worked.

concept_diagnosis.aachu_proof: Low box-level wide view in a lived-in home study corner during a clear-out. An open desk drawer and plain discard carton establish the action. A worn unlabelled folder has just landed in the carton. Aachu's right hand has released it while Zuv bends and retrieves its edge with a fully traceable right arm. Aachu faces the drawer and is already moving to the next item; Zuv's gaze and torso point only toward the folder. Exactly two people, no background figures, mirrors, portraits, silhouettes, or readable secondary text.
concept_diagnosis.bridge: discard -> exposure -> chronology -> re-seeing -> voluntary continuation
concept_diagnosis.earned_ending: So she added today's unfinished page.
concept_diagnosis.send_save_reason: Open the loop: why did he rescue the least impressive object?
